description: The next free posting times per account, skipping times already taken by other posts. Pass post_id to plan that post's accounts. Every account has times: its own, the workspace's, or suggested ones (suggested: true) from its numbers or its network's usual hours.

account_id.description: Account to find slots on (a UUID): from accounts_list; omit for the post's accounts

post_id.description: Post to find the next free slots for (a UUID): from post_list

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: slots_next
title: Next free posting times
